header.title: Daily Chinese reading
header.description: A library of reviewed daily readings stored in HanziHome.

empty.title: No collected readings yet
empty.description: HanziHome currently shows only readings that have been packaged and reviewed.

sample.title: Try Reader with a sample, not a collected article

document.notFound: This daily reading was not found in the available data.

attempts.anonymousLocalOnly: You are not signed in. Answers still work for this study session, but practice history will not be saved to an account.

grammar.empty: This reading has no dedicated grammar items yet.

source.title: Source and editorial notes
source.fallbackNotice: This content was reviewed before being added to the library.

generated.description: Find a real Chinese news article, extract the source, then build a 学习版 with vocabulary, grammar, and questions. Generated readings are stored locally on this device.
generated.progressHint: This can take a few minutes because the source, reading, learning material, validation, and local save all run in sequence.
generated.notFound: This locally saved Daily Reading could not be found.

library.title: Readings built from real sources
library.description: Each reading is a 学习版 produced from a news source whose domain and extracted content were checked first.
library.emptyTitle: No AI-generated readings on this device yet.
library.emptyDescription: Create the first one now, or leave auto-generation enabled for a {level} reading after 10:00.

toast.failed: Daily Reading could not be created.

settings.title: Daily Reading
settings.description: Configure how HanziHome captures source articles and adds optional AI support. Status, library, and task history live in the Daily Reading workspace.

auto.title: Automatic generation
auto.description: At most one scheduled reading is created per day. Temporary failures retry with limits, and multiple tabs do not create duplicates.
auto.aria: Enable or disable automatic Daily Reading generation

pipeline.title: Source check and generation
pipeline.description: Current progress for the latest run. Validation steps keep the learning edition source-bound and schema-valid.
pipeline.sourceDescription: Find and extract a new article from an allowed source.
pipeline.readingDescription: Write a new 学习版 grounded in source facts.
pipeline.learningDescription: Create vocabulary, grammar, questions, and evidence.
pipeline.validateDescription: Check schema, source grounding, duplication, and evidence.
pipeline.saveDescription: Store the validated reading on this device.

history.title: Run history
history.description: The six most recent runs on this device. Each row shows the exact running or failed stage.

errors.tooShort: The draft did not pass the quality checks. Automatic repair was attempted but did not finish.
errors.schema: The AI returned a draft with an invalid structure or field value. Automatic repair was attempted but did not finish.
errors.provider: No personal AI provider completed the reading. Check the active API key and selected model in AI settings.

clearDialog.title: Delete generated Daily Readings?
clearDialog.description: This removes automatically and manually generated readings from the current browser.
clearDialog.body: {count} saved readings will be deleted. Run history is kept for diagnostics.

toast.sourceFailed: Could not test sources with the current criteria.
toast.generationFailed: Daily Reading could not be created.
toast.cleared: Generated Daily Readings were removed from this device.
toast.captureFailed: Could not find a new source article.
toast.settingFailed: Could not save Daily Reading settings on this device.

capture.title: Source article
capture.description: Choose when and what kind of article HanziHome should find. A saved article counts as complete even when AI support is not ready yet.
capture.autoTitle: Find one article automatically each day
capture.autoDescription: At the selected time the app finds a new article; if the app is closed, it catches up on the next open.
capture.levelDescription: Guides learning support only; it never rewrites the Chinese source article.
capture.todayDue: Capture time has passed; waiting to find an article
capture.sourceIndependent: Source testing only checks discovery and extraction; it does not use an AI API key.

sourcePreview.title: Latest source test
sourcePreview.notPersisted: This is only a source test. The article has not been added to the library.

ai.title: AI learning support
ai.description: AI creates Vietnamese translation, vocabulary, grammar, and questions after the source article has already been saved.
ai.autoTitle: Automatically add learning support after capture
ai.autoDescription: When a usable API key exists, the app creates missing learning modules after saving the article. AI failure never makes the source article fail.
ai.translationDescription: Create a Vietnamese translation of the source article.
ai.vocabularyDescription: Select the exact configured number of learning items.
ai.grammarDescription: Select the exact configured number of evidenced grammar points.
ai.questionsDescription: Create the exact configured number of comprehension questions.
ai.missing: No AI API key yet. Source articles can still be found and read normally.
ai.storageUnavailable: Secure server-side API key storage is not ready. Source article capture is unaffected.
ai.credentialUnreadable: A saved key cannot currently be read. You can add a replacement key without affecting source articles.
ai.articleIndependent: Source capture and AI are independent states: the article succeeds first, and learning support can be added or retried later.

advanced.title: Advanced sources and criteria
advanced.description: Adjust these only when you want tighter control over sources, freshness, length, or topic diversity.
advanced.freshnessDescription: First consider only articles published within this window.
advanced.diversityDescription: Reduce the chance of repeating topics read recently.
advanced.avoidRecentDescription: Exclude URLs already present in the local library from the next search.
advanced.topicsDescription: Select at least one topic. The app still applies its safety content policy.
advanced.sourcesDescription: Search only the reviewed publisher allowlist.
advanced.atLeastOneTopic: Keep at least one topic selected.
advanced.atLeastOneSource: Keep at least one source selected.

library.description: The Chinese source article is saved first. Translation, vocabulary, grammar, and questions are separate AI learning support that can be added later.

tabs.aria: Daily Reading library and activity history

status.todayDue: Capture time passed; waiting for the task

activity.title: Activity history
activity.description: The actual log of source captures and AI learning-support runs on this device, newest first.
activity.emptyDescription: When Daily Reading captures an article or creates learning support, its status and time will appear here.

management.title: Saved articles
management.description: {count} articles are stored on this device. Manage article content here; task history is kept separately for diagnostics.
management.dialogDescription: Review or delete articles stored on this device. Deleting an article does not delete capture or AI activity history.
management.emptyDescription: Newly captured articles will appear here.
management.confirmArticleDescription: “{title}” will be removed from this device's library.
management.confirmAllDescription: This removes {count} saved articles from this device.
management.historyPreserved: Task history remains available so you can review timestamps, statuses, and previous errors.

toast.deleteFailed: Could not delete Daily Reading articles on this device.

enrichment.title: AI learning support
enrichment.description: The Chinese text above always remains the saved source article. These modules only add meanings and exercises; they never rewrite the source.
enrichment.runtimeReused: Reused the result from {provider} · {key} · {model}; AI was not called again
enrichment.runtimeMissing: No AI API key yet. You can still read the complete source article.
enrichment.runtimeStorageUnavailable: Server-side API key storage is not ready; the source article remains fully readable.
enrichment.runtimeCheckFailed: AI status could not be checked right now. The source article remains readable; try the status check again.

translation.title: Vietnamese translation
translation.description: Translate each saved paragraph closely while preserving paragraph IDs.

vocabulary.title: Article vocabulary
vocabulary.description: Only words and phrases that actually occur in the source article are accepted.

grammar.title: Grammar with evidence
grammar.description: Every grammar point must include a complete sentence from the source article.

questions.title: Reading questions
questions.description: Questions and answers must point back to specific source paragraphs.

toast.allReady: All learning support modules are ready.
toast.queued: The AI job is queued. You can leave this page; the result will be imported when it finishes.
